sources.note: Stratton School District records supplied by the Town Clerk's office (Candie Bernard, via Town Clerk Kent Young) on 2026-10-26 in reply to CivicMirror's records request of 2026-10-25: (1) the Warning for the March 3, 2026 Annual School District Meeting (signed by directors Walker, D'Elia-Laskin, Frigo and Crowther) -- Article 2 warned four director seats: one two-year term to complete a three-year term, one three-year term, and two one-year terms; (2) the signed minutes of the March 3, 2026 meeting (Minutes by Town Clerk David Kent Young; approved by the Stratton School Directors) -- Article 2 elected Joe Frigo to the last two years of a three-year term, Kellie D'Elia-Laskin to a three-year term, and Morgan Taylor to a one-year term; the second one-year seat drew no nominations and remained vacant (the minutes note discussion of filling 'the vacant school board position'); (3) the Stratton School Board minutes of April 21, 2026 (draft) -- reorganization (Walker Chair, Frigo Vice-Chair, Taylor Clerk) and, at item 4, the board's unanimous appointment of Madeline Wadolowski to the vacant seat. These documents GOVERN the roster. 'Maddie Mindich,' minted 2026-10-22 from the SU page's fifth member card, appears in none of them and her person and membership were removed on 2026-10-26.

Windham Central SU "Stratton Board Members" page (official), read from the page's raw HTML on 2026-10-22 (member names are dropped by rendered-text extraction) and re-checked 2026-10-26: five cards -- Melissa Walker (Chairperson), term length 3, expiry 2027; Joe Frigo (Vice-Chairperson), term length 1, expiry 2026; Morgan Taylor (Clerk), term length 3, expiry 2029; Kellie D'Elia-Laskin (Member), term length 3, expiry 2026; and a fifth card ('Maddie Mindich') with no term data. The page is STALE: it still shows Frigo's and D'Elia-Laskin's terms expiring at the March 2026 election at which both were re-elected, and its Taylor expiry (2029) contradicts the signed meeting minutes (one-year term, ending 2027). It is retained as a source for Walker's term only (her seat was not before the March 3, 2026 meeting). Board size five is as the SU page presents the board (a section 423(b) expansion implied, the vote itself not fetched).

directors.name: Melissa Walker
directors.note: Chairperson (re-elected chair at the April 21, 2026 reorganization). Term per the SU board page; her seat was not before the March 3, 2026 annual meeting.

directors.name: Joe Frigo
directors.note: Vice-Chairperson. Elected March 3, 2026 to the last two years of a three-year term (annual meeting minutes, Article 2). Previously HELD pending this document.

directors.name: Kellie D'Elia-Laskin
directors.note: Elected March 3, 2026 to a three-year term (annual meeting minutes, Article 2). Previously HELD pending this document.

directors.name: Morgan Taylor
directors.note: Board Clerk (officer role not modeled). Elected March 3, 2026 to a one-year term (annual meeting minutes, Article 2). CORRECTED 2026-10-26: the original mint carried end '2029' from the SU board page's stale card; the signed minutes govern.

directors.name: Madeline Wadolowski
directors.note: Appointed by the Stratton School Board on April 21, 2026 to the one-year seat left unfilled at the March 3, 2026 annual meeting (no nominations were made for it); the appointment runs to the seat's 2027 expiry (April 21, 2026 board minutes, item 4; motion by Frigo, seconded by Walker, unanimous; appointee to be sworn in by the town clerk).
